entities.summary: Ibn Amira (1186- 1258/60), full name: Abū al-Muṭarrif Aḥmad bin Abdallāh bin al-Ḥusayn bin Aḥmad Ibn Amīra al-Makhzūmī was a historian, poet, and scholar of law from al-Andalus during the reign of the Almohads. Ibn Amira was Qadi of Mallorca and worked for the Almohad sultan in Valencia and Seville. He moved to modern-day Morocco in 1239/40 and continued to work for the sultan there.
